name: forgemind
description: Evidence-first discovery and delivery for Codex: market-tested MVPs, safe execution, and release-ready proof.

interface.shortDescription: Maximum-USP innovation portfolios and verifiable MVP delivery.
interface.longDescription: ForgeMind turns a new or existing app into a ranked innovation portfolio: differentiated product bets with explicit evidence basis, moat, monetization hypothesis, MVP experiment, and kill condition. It then routes the selected bet through market-tested, evidence-backed delivery. YOLO mode remains available for bounded fast MVPs while destructive, credential, production, and high-stakes actions always stop for approval. All records stay local on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
defaultPrompt: Use $forgemind-explore to find the strongest MVP opportunity in this app.
Use $forgemind-build to implement and verify this outcome.
Use $forgemind-guide to choose the best next step for this goal.
